0x0008BC.en: 「Guh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x000944.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A6D.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000AA5.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, geez!」

0x000B6E.en: 「Ngh! So this is where I fall...!」

0x000BA9.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　Not funny...」

0x000BFD.en: 「Botched it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000C71.en: 「Guh! No choice but to fall back!!」

0x000D4E.en: 「This is the end... the rest is on you.」

0x000DFA.en: 「No good, took too much damage... Retreating!」

0x000E47.en: 「Well, I'm done for. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E85.en: 「Kyah, I leave the rest to you!」

0x000ECC.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F77.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the one turning into a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x000FF6.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go...!」

0x001167.en: 「Sorry... the rest is up to you.」

0x00119C.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x001259.en: 「Ngh... you're as good as they say.」

0x001288.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I've still got a lot to learn...!」

0x0012D6.en: 「No good, I can't hold on! Retreating!」

0x0013C0.en: 「No good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x00142D.en: 「I can't go on any further. I'll be taking my leave.」

0x0014B8.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll fall back for now...!」

0x0016DC.en: 「Guhhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x00184B.en: 「So I've still got a way to go...!」

0x0019CC.en: 「...I think I understand my situation@ now, more or less.」

0x001A22.en: 「I'm sorry. I can't tell you much@ about this ship, either...」

0x001A87.en: 「Honestly, even we don't know much@ about La Gias ourselves.」

0x001AE9.en: 「...I understand that this is an emergency.」

0x001B90.en: 「...I watched your exchange with him@ over the monitor.」

0x001C02.en: 「I don't see any signs of shock@ over losing his memory... though that@ may just be his calm temperament.」

0x001CBF.en: 「That's what worried us, too.@ No panic, no grief... he just accepts@ the situation, flat and matter-of-fact...」

0x001D6A.en: 「In Mai's case, there were@ flashbacks, but...」

0x001E28.en: 「He's had combat training, it seems,@ but beyond that, nothing in particular...」

0x001E7E.en: 「Our equipment here may simply be@ unable to detect it. That was the@ case with me, after all.」

0x001F12.en: 「Prior conditioning, or a resistance...@ But I checked the data too, and there's@ no match. Not so far, anyway.」

0x001FDF.en: 「...I'm speaking of possibilities.@ It could be no conditioning was needed,@ or his memory really is gone.」

0x0020E0.en: 「No. He accepts our requests@ without complaint, and shows no sign@ of probing into anything.」

0x002164.en: 「I just wish there were something@ to jog even a little of his memory...」

0x0021C3.en: 「If he's a mecha pilot, how about@ putting him in a <PT> simulator?」

0x002270.en: 「Right. The way he handles a machine@ might tell us something.」

0x0022C3.en: 「Understood. I'll discuss it with the@ Captain and the doctor later.」

0x002316.en: 「...Captain, it's almost time for the@ briefing on the capital assault.」

0x002375.en: 「Right. Let's head to the@ briefing room.」

0x0023F0.en: 「I've seen the terrain data on the@ capital and its surroundings. Expected@ enemy strength?」

0x00245B.en: 「Those Sodium-class we ran into at@ Coral Canyon... no doubt several of@ them are stationed there.」

0x00252E.en: 「No, there's a chance they've summoned@ Stork-class from the ground.」

0x0025AC.en: 「And where is Princess Monica being held?」

0x002629.en: 「Either way, we have to take the palace@ back from the Shutedonias bastards.@ That's our goal, settled.」

0x0026ED.en: 「First, we approach Mount Ginas as@ undetected as possible... and draw off@ the enemy ships posted around the capital.」

0x002783.en: 「Every machine except Cybuster, Gaddess,@ Altairlion, and Rein Weissritter@ diverts the enemy...」

0x00281C.en: 「At the same time, Masaki's team storms@ the palace. Our numbers are few, so Cyflash@ is the key. Don't misjudge when to use it.」

0x0028E9.en: 「With Grungust Kai and the SRX, can't@ we manage even if they outnumber us?」

0x00296D.en: 「No. As it stands, the R-Series can't@ combine into the SRX.」

0x0029D5.en: 「The R-1 right now only has a rough@ emergency setup for the exercises, just@ enough to let Mai adjust to it.」

0x002A74.en: 「To combine, we'd need a lot of time@ for reconfiguration and tuning.」

0x002AD6.en: 「Then it might honestly be quicker to@ go track down Ryusei...」

0x002B54.en: 「...Captain, please come to the bridge@ at once. An unknown is closing on us.」

0x002BCB.en: 「Understood. Sound Condition One battle@ stations. ...The rest of you, sortie now.」

0x002CB0.en: 「We have a match!@ Th-this is... the G-Granzon!」

0x002D7F.en: 「The Granzon... no, the Neo Granzon@ was destroyed back then...!」

0x002DD5.en: 「Yeah, we beat it!@ There's no way it could be here!」

0x002E2B.en: 「Then the pilot is Christoph...@ no, isn't that Shu Shirakawa...?」

0x002E9F.en: 「Someone other than Shu can pilot@ the Granzon...!?」

0x002EFB.en: 「Oh? It seems you all@ know me as well.」

0x002FB4.en: 「...It seems I'm feared and resented@ in a great many places.」

0x003028.en: 「What!? What the hell are you saying!?」

0x00306B.en: 「...That crude way of speaking...@ I feel like I should remember it...」

0x0030BE.en: 「Quit talking nonsense!@ Don't tell me you've forgotten me!」

0x00317F.en: 「Could it be he's lost his memory...!?」

0x0031C8.en: 「Before that, how did he even come back?」

0x00322A.en: 「If you have no memory, then why@ show yourself before us?」

0x003283.en: 「I'd like you to deal with them,@ that's all. Now, I must be off.」

0x003359.en: 「Shutedonias unit, approaching!@ Coming in at an angle from two o'clock!」

0x0033FC.en: 「Chasing it down with that many...@ Shutedonias must consider Shu important too.」

0x00348B.en: 「And if they catch on to our goal,@ they'll tighten the guard on the capital.」

0x0034EA.en: 「Tch, that bastard Shu@ had to go and stir up trouble...!」

0x00356B.en: 「Shu can wait!@ Captain, now that we've been spotted here,@ we've got no choice but to smash that unit!」

0x003616.en: 「Agreed. I'd rather not be caught in a@ pincer. All units, intercept.」

0x003663.en: (Heh, you've grown, Masaki. The old you@ would've chased after Shu no matter@ what stood in the way.)

0x0036FA.en: 「That surface-dweller warship, here of@ all places...! Kibbon, take your unit@ and pursue the Granzon!」

0x003788.en: 「Contact the main force at the capital!@ Tell them the enemy's launched a two-front@ attack and to stay fully alert!」

0x00385C.en: 「Well, no matter.@ We've got an even bigger prize instead:@ the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x0038E0.en: 「To make a buck, obviously.@　Tell you what, I'll lend you a hand too, so@　just sweeten my paycheck a little.」

0x003998.en: 「It's shaped a little different from@ that Kerberion from before...!」

0x0039E2.en: 「I'm Chien Argent.@　Same <Boosted Children> as Chienne.」

0x003A63.en: 「Heh... if word gets out we took you down,@　we're the winners even back on the surface.」

0x003ACE.en: 「Same look, and the personality's about the same too.」

0x003B14.en: 「No offense to Chienne, but this glory's mine.@　You lot get to be the losers.@　Say your prayers!」

0x003B9E.en: 「High-speed fliers incoming! Straight in from ten o'clock!@　Two of them!」

0x003C10.en: 「No, they're squawking a friendly IFF code!@ It's the Razangriff Raven and@ the Randgriz Raven!」

0x003CAF.en: 「Ahh, thank goodness.@　Finally, a familiar face.」

0x003D05.en: 「Carla, you and the others came to La Gias too...!」

0x003D55.en: 「We got hassled by some crazy bunch and@　had a real rough time of it, in all sorts of ways.」

0x003DE2.en: 「Yuu, that unit!@　It's the one that picked a fight with us@　right before we got dragged over here!」

0x003E54.en: 「Yeah, but it looks like there's only one of them...」

0x003EB0.en: 「No idea who they are, but we were in the middle@　of fighting them when we got flung into this world.」

0x003F24.en: 「Details later. Give us a hand here.」

0x003F86.en: 「Persistent little pests.@　Launch the remaining units!」

0x003FD3.en: 「Those Shutedonias bastards,@　don't get cocky with us!」

0x004026.en: 「Tch, they're really something!@　But I've got no intention of being a loser!」

0x0040BC.en: 「No enemy contacts remaining in the combat zone.」

0x0040E4.en: 「Good. Stay sharp for air and ground threats.@　Bring all units back aboard.」

0x004134.en: 「You bastards, why are you after Shu!?」

0x004177.en: 「I've no reason to tell the likes of you!」

0x0041DF.en: 「So what if I am!@　Just shut up and be my prey!」

0x004244.en: 「Wait, are you Chienne's brother, by any chance?」

0x004284.en: 「Not exactly, but that's@　none of your business!」

0x0042E3.en: 「So you came to this world too...!」

0x00431D.en: 「That's my line!@　Well, wherever we are, the job's the same!」

0x00438B.en: 「Perfect timing. Let's pick up where we left off!」

0x0043CB.en: 「Just who the heck are you people!?」

0x004402.en: 「Boosted Children!@　Only we're a cut above Bronzo!」

0x00446A.en: 「We were out at sea tagging along on a test@ of the rebuilt DyGenGuard...@ when that Chien guy jumped us.」

0x004521.en: 「And we got dragged over here just like that.」

0x004555.en: 「Then Boss must've been summoned too, for sure.」

0x00459B.en: 「Could Kurogane and my brother be here as well?」

0x0045CC.en: 「No way to know.@　We were nowhere near the Kurogane.」

0x004628.en: 「Still, that Chien guy...@　so he was a Boosted Child.」

0x00469C.en: 「Right, but his situation seems a lot@　different from Arado and the rest.」

0x0046FB.en: 「Down on the surface, he was calling us traitors.@　Think maybe they're <Neue DC> remnants?」

0x0047EE.en: 「The Boosted Children you ran into,@　were they just Chienne and Chien?」

0x004865.en: 「No, there was one more of those@ Kerberion units.」

0x0048F2.en: 「Anyway, glad we could link up with the Hagane.@　Captain, may we keep accompanying you from here?」

0x004991.en: 「Masaki, you're worried about Shu, aren't you?」

0x0049D7.en: 「Yeah... to think that guy was still alive...」

0x004A17.en: 「If the amnesia's real, then what caused it?」

0x004A5D.en: 「...His coming back and all,@　might be tied up with Louzorl.」

0x004AF0.en: 「Anyway, after this the Shutedonias army@ will have hardened the capital's defenses. We should@ rethink the assault and scout first, but...」

0x004BB3.en: 「...Captain, we're receiving a transmission@　from someone calling himself@　Feil-Lord Gran Bilseia.」

0x004C87.en: 「Azuki, patch the line through to me.」

0x004CF2.en: 「At last, the prince of Langran makes his entrance.」

0x004D83.en: 「Th-thank you, Freki.@　...Nothing looks off, does it?」

0x004E42.en: 「Tytti, are you sweet on the prince...?」

0x004E82.en: 「Th-that's not it at all.@　I'm just tidying up my appearance...」

0x004EE4.en: 「...Forgive this sudden discourtesy.@　I am the first prince of the Holy Langran Kingdom,@　Feil-Lord Gran Bilseia.」

0x004F95.en: 「I'm Lt. Col. Tetsuya Onodera,@ captain of the Hagane,@ Earth Federation Far East Army 1st Special Independent Wing.」

0x005028.en: 「We caught wind of your movements over here as well.@　Even so, our contact came late, and I apologize for it.」

0x00513E.en: 「Ah, Masaki. Good to have you back.@　And I'm glad Tytti is safe as well.」

0x0051A6.en: 「Your Highness, I trust you are in good spirits...」

0x0051E9.en: 「Let me be brief. On the Nakut Plains we@　succeeded in crushing the Shutedonias army.@　Now, to retake the capital, I need your strength.」

0x0052B8.en: 「We're currently encamped in the city of Banan.@　If you're willing to join us, come quickly.」

0x005335.en: 「Understood, Your Highness.@　I'll bring Masaki and head your way at once.」

0x005397.en: 「Our ship will lend its aid as well.@　We were already planning to storm the capital with Masaki.」

0x0053FF.en: 「I'm grateful for it.@　Then, I'll be waiting in Banan.」

0x00544F.en: 「...My, my. A prince who'd put even our own@　lady-killer to shame. Though when it comes to@　the voice, that's a tough call between them.」
